content.comment_body: I'm working with a circuit that uses a delay timer. The timer value appears in a text message, but right now the message counts up to the target value. I'd like it to instead count down from the set value. Is there a way to achieve this? Possibly by using a second counter that activates when the delay starts and counts down, with the text message referencing that instead. Any suggestions would be welcome. Thanks, [user_name]

Hello, this functionality is available in the newer [product_name] [article_no]. With this version, you can include the remaining time directly in a text message, which isn't possible with older [product_name] versions. Hope this clarifies things.
This worked perfectly, and I also learned more about the [product_name] programming software. Thanks for your help, [user_name]
